verdict.rationale: OpenHands is an autonomous coding agent. It documents taking natural-language tasks, working toward a set goal with stop/resume controls, and autonomously updating code and opening pull requests. Those PR examples cover fixes and remediations rather than new features, and nothing in the evidence mentions the agent writing or running tests. missing for 10: explicit documentation of end-to-end feature implementation, evidence the agent writes tests, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests

citations.quote: Type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback
the user sets an objective, the agent keeps working toward it, and the UI can show progress with stop/resume controls
Review security alerts, validate the finding, update affected code, and open a pull request with the remediation.
Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
